messages:
anya: quick update from a redispatch slice I ran (EU->us-west cross-zone). goal was to compare A100 vs H100 for 7B prefill+decode under our steady QPS slice. results are interesting, posting highlights + raw numbers below.

mikko: nice, drop the p95s and tokens/sec pls. was this with quant or fp16?

anya: FP16 runtime for baseline. quant runs after. summary: H100 prefill p95 ~260ms, A100 prefill p95 ~320ms (~18.8% faster on H100). decode per-token p95 pretty close: A100 14.2ms/token, H100 13.6ms/token. tokens/sec (end-to-end per-GPU): A100 1.18k tps, H100 1.25k tps. cost rough $/1M tokens: A100 $0.51, H100 $0.44 (region-backed pricing + throughput).

bench-bot: CSV export attached (gist): https://gist.github.com/redwood/bench-2112345678

bench-bot: ```
model,region,gpu,prefill_p95_ms,decode_p95_ms,tokens_sec,cost_per_1M_tokens
redwood-7b,eu-west-1,A100,320,14.2,1180,0.51
redwood-7b,eu-west-1,H100,260,13.6,1250,0.44
redwood-7b,us-west-2,A100,310,13.9,1200,0.50
redwood-7b,ap-south-1,A100,350,15.1,1100,0.58
redwood-7b,ap-south-1,H100,290,14.4,1160,0.52
```

sara: good to see consistent wins for H100 on prefill. that ~8% decode win is small but aggregated decreases tail. what's the kernel story? cuBLAS or TensorRT path?

anya: default runtime picked cuBLAS kernels for prefill, decode on fused attention path. i forced TensorRT on H100 for one run and saw another ~6% prefill drop but stability issues on long sequences (occasional OOMs).

mikko: did you try int8 quant? we saw ~10-12% perf but some regressed outputs on our QA prompt set last week.

anya: yes. int8 (GPTQ-like) on H100 yields prefill p95 ~235ms and tokens/sec ~1.37k, cost $0.37/1M — but QA eval showed a 1.9% BLEU/ROUGE-ish drift on our regression set (short factual prompts). leaving flagged.

evan: can you paste the eval gist? that quality delta is important for prod customers.

anya: https://gist.github.com/redwood/bench-evals-2112345678 (contains prompt set + diff heatmap). short summary: failures are mostly temporal factuality and number hallucinations on few-shot prompts.

ops-bot: note: cross-zone egress adds ~6-8% to latency and cost for EU->US runs; sizing suggestion: if you want H100 in eu-west for this slice, reserve 20% extra headroom for burst and kernel fallback.

mikko: for Dedicated SKU planning — sounds like H100 gives better unit economics if you care about tail prefill. if quality must be identical, stick fp16 on A100 or H100 with cuBLAS. int8 should be opt-in with quality gating.

anya: next steps: 1) run a longer stability sweep with TensorRT on H100 (long sequences), 2) run quant eval gating on the production prompt set (50k prompts), 3) re-run cost model with reserved sku pricing (not spot). I'll open a GH issue with the artifacts.

sara: thanks. add a note about fallback policy: prefer H100->A100 fallback not H100->smaller variants (we saw token reordering once). :warning:

anya: noted. filing the issue now.``
